name: Wanderweg 601
description_md:
Wanderweg 601 is a 29.6 km waymarked hiking route in Austria. Signposted as 601, it forms part of a regional waymarked hiking network and has a difficulty of hard, derived from distance and ascent.

The route involves 2813 m of ascent and 1652 m of descent. Walking time is about 16 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It passes the Hallstatt-Dachstein Salzkammergut cultural landscape within 300 m and Hallstatt within 600 m.
